manual.title: A reduction formula
manual.prompt:
Let $I_n=\displaystyle\int_0^{1}x^{n}e^{x}\,dx$ for integers $n\ge0$.

By differentiating $x^{n}e^{x}$, show that $I_n=e-nI_{n-1}$ for $n\ge1$.
